name: Pericyclic Reaction Benchmark
description: A set of high-accuracy reference reaction energies (targeting CCSDT(Q)/CBS) for pericyclic reactions used to evaluate density functional theory performance.
evaluation_method: mean absolute error (MAE) / root mean squared error (RMSE) against high-accuracy reference energies (reported in kcal/mol)
typical_sota_score: DFT functionals typically exhibit MAE ≈ 1–5 kcal/mol; high-level correlated methods approach ≪1 kcal/mol relative to reference (varies by system)
reputation: Well-regarded among computational chemists as a targeted, high-accuracy benchmark for assessing density functional theory methods on pericyclic reaction energetics.
notes: Non-LLM scientific benchmark; small specialized set of reactions computed at very high reference accuracy (CCSDT(Q)/CBS), computationally expensive to reproduce; primarily used for method benchmarking rather than large-scale ML training.
